review: Independent check. Kinetic match forces alpha = K/4 and beta = -K/4. For a generic symmetric field, sqrt(g) R equals R1 at first order and its second order differs from R2 by a divergence. The Legendre transform of the pull holds through order v^4. On 1s the clock-only ratio is 4/3; on 2p0 the axial ratio is 3/5, so the clock-only ratio along z is 8/5. With the momentum books, one-half Theta.h for the drifting lengths is d(t xi.P)/dt - xi.P plus a divergence. The non-axis exchange and the full W=1 cancellation were not rebuilt.

It prints `HIT: confirmed - <the claim survives; what you verified independently>` or `SUMMARY: fails at step <n> - <why>`; always a SUMMARY line. If your model family is the author's, release the unit.
